name: LC-70 laser cannon
description: The LC-70 laser cannon was a model of laser cannon that could be equipped to starships. Upgrading an EML-850 light freighter previously equipped with the slower LC-60 laser cannons to LC-70s cost 1500 credits and required a X-FP-C28 ship computer, fifteen units of quadanium steel, and seven enhanced durasteel hulls.
